note: Chester County park (1,000+ acres) near Coatesville PA. RV-capable at the 19 Fiddler's Campground sites, which the county says take tents, small camp trailers and RVs (access depths 25-60 ft); the 20 Lake Campground sites are tent-only. No hookups, no dump station. Reservations online/phone or first-come self-registration; open weekends April through the second full weekend in November. Chambers Lake and Brandywine Creek are in the park but the RV-capable sites are wooded/inland. --Claude
